decisions.decision: CLIProxy as Priority 1, Gemini SDK as fallback
decisions.reason: CLIProxy provides free multi-model access (GPT, Claude, Gemini) via self-hosted proxy

decisions.decision: Brain v2 split files (project/domain/knowledge/features/session)
decisions.reason: Legacy brain.json 40KB too large — split for faster reads and safer edits

decisions.decision: Two-step speaker notes (raw → optimized)
decisions.reason: Raw generation then QA/TTS optimization produces better audio quality

decisions.decision: syncSpeakerNotesToSlideAudios updates existing records, NOT delete+recreate
decisions.reason: Deleting SlideAudio records would lose existing audio files

decisions.decision: refreshLessonDataOnly() separate from refreshLessonData()
decisions.reason: fetchLessonData overwrites currentStep from backend state. Must preserve client-side step when navigating

decisions.decision: CLIProxy model discovery includes ALL models by default
decisions.reason: Users should see all available models. Classification done via name pattern matching

decisions.decision: Support 4 response formats in CLIProxy TTS parser
decisions.reason: CLIProxy returns audio in non-standard format — future-proofing

decisions.decision: Always override fallback model to hardcoded 'gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts'
decisions.reason: CLIProxy display name is invalid for Gemini SDK

decisions.decision: VietNormalizer DISABLED in v1.1.1
decisions.reason: Causes audio quality degradation (mispronounced words). TTS optimization handled by AI prompt instead

decisions.decision: Nginx timeout set to 600s
decisions.reason: AI generation (questions, speaker notes) can take 2-5 minutes. 180s was too short, causing false-negative errors on VPS.

decisions.decision: SVG favicon instead of PNG
decisions.reason: Scalable, crisp at all sizes, no generation dependency

decisions.decision: Use file-based debug logging for TTS debugging
decisions.reason: Terminal logs could not be read via tools — file-based logging effective for remote debugging

decisions.decision: ViTTS OmniVoice: default mode = 'auto' (not 'clone')
decisions.reason: Clone requires UUID ref_id. 'auto' is safe fallback that needs no extra params

decisions.decision: ViTTS OmniVoice async polling with 3-min timeout
decisions.reason: POST returns job_id → poll GET /jobs/{id} until completed/failed. 3 min covers long audio generation

decisions.decision: Voice Design instruct: exact comma-separated items only
decisions.reason: API rejects 'A female, young speaker'. Must use exact items: 'female, young adult, high pitch'

decisions.decision: Translate Vietnamese Visual Idea to English specific Flux prompt
decisions.reason: Flux/ComfyUI prompts require specific structure. Vietnamese causes hallucinated results. Done in optimizeFluxPrompt().

decisions.decision: Multilingual system via Prompt Composer injection
decisions.reason: Using a single `{output_language_instruction}` placeholder in ALL system prompts instead of duplicating DB seeds per language.

decisions.decision: Removed TTS Dictionary and TextNormalizerService completely
decisions.reason: Functionality is natively handled by external TTS providers. Eliminates unneeded overhead and 17K DB records.

decisions.decision: Rewrite ALL system prompts from Vietnamese to English
decisions.reason: English prompts produce higher quality AI output. Language control via injected {output_language_instruction} placeholder ensures correct output language regardless of prompt language.

decisions.decision: ImageGen URL rewrite pattern (localhost → configured API host)
decisions.reason: Remote ImageGen APIs commonly return localhost URLs. Transparent URL rewriting more robust than requiring server-side config changes.

decisions.decision: SDK fallback always uses GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL constant for ImageGen models
decisions.reason: ImageGen model names (flux-image) don't exist in Gemini SDK. isImageGenModel flag must force correct fallback model.

decisions.decision: Speaker notes 'PLAIN TEXT ONLY' TTS rule + 'Act as professional lecturer' persona
decisions.reason: Combining user's reference prompt style (natural presenter tone, no markdown) with existing quality requirements produces better TTS-ready output.

decisions.decision: Rewrite _add_audio_with_autoplay using direct XML/Part instead of add_movie()
decisions.reason: python-pptx 1.0.2 add_movie() throws 'Part has no attribute sha1' for WAV/MP3 audio. Direct XML manipulation with Part+PackURI+relationship bypasses this limitation.

decisions.decision: ViTTS base URL 8888 (not 8000)
decisions.reason: Port 8000 is used by ImageGen/Flux API. ViTTS OmniVoice production server runs on port 8888.

decisions.decision: Centralize credentials in NestJS (Single Source of Truth) for video generation
decisions.reason: Avoids .env duplication on Python worker nodes. API keys (Gemini, CLIProxy, MinIO, viTTS, ImageGen) are bundled into a Redis job payload via JobConfig.

decisions.decision: Stateless Python worker architecture
decisions.reason: Allows easy scaling. Worker node only needs REDIS_URL to function, and explicitly receives credentials per-job.

decisions.decision: Use manim-render (NOT manimgl) for headless video rendering
decisions.reason: manimgl sets ended_with_interrupt=True in xvfb mode, leaving _temp.mp4 files unfinalized. manim-render properly completes the output file.

decisions.decision: ManimGL Tex only (no MathTex)
decisions.reason: ManimGL v1.7.2 repo 3b1b/manim has NO MathTex class. Only Tex (math mode via align*) and TexText (text mode). MathTex is ManimCE-only.

decisions.decision: Read user TTS config in video-gen via ModelConfigService.getModelForTask(userId, 'TTS')
decisions.reason: Video pipeline was ignoring user's saved OmniVoice clone ref preference. Same pattern used by lesson pipeline (slide-audio.service.ts).

decisions.decision: Force Approach enforcement: backend sends forcedApproach via job payload
decisions.reason: When user selects style=manim, ALL scenes must be manim — no silent fallback to static. Worker receives forcedApproach in config and skips static renderer.

decisions.decision: Scene-by-scene render workflow (not batch render)
decisions.reason: Users need to preview, approve, and optionally re-render each scene individually before composing final video. Prevents wasted computation on full re-renders.

decisions.decision: Manim Reference Dictionary from 3b1b codebase
decisions.reason: 4,915 scenes scanned from 417 files in 3b1b/videos + example_scenes.py. 50 selected patterns in 10 categories. Injected as few-shot examples into AI prompt for better code generation quality.

decisions.decision: Self-healing AI loop for Manim code generation
decisions.reason: Generate → AST validate → dry-run → if fail: send error+code back to AI → fix → retry (max 2x). Reduces manual intervention needed for syntax/runtime errors.

decisions.decision: Audio and Video render are independent (no audio required before render)
decisions.reason: Manim produces visual-only clips. Audio TTS runs separately. FFmpeg compose_scene() merges them at compose step using tpad freeze-frame to sync durations. User can preview video without audio.

decisions.decision: Clip streaming through backend (not direct MinIO URL)
decisions.reason: MinIO object paths stored in DB are not public URLs. Backend proxies clip streaming via GET /scenes/:idx/stream/clip endpoint with JWT auth.

decisions.decision: start.sh kills all stale worker.py processes on stop
decisions.reason: Zombie workers from old sessions compete for Redis queue jobs, causing render-scene jobs to be consumed by outdated code that doesn't support new modes.

decisions.decision: Lesson Studio Pro as independent module (zero-impact on existing code)
decisions.reason: Existing 6-step flow is in production. New 7-step skill-powered flow must not break anything. Only 4 additive changes to existing files (schema.prisma, app.module.ts, App.tsx, SubjectDetail.tsx).

decisions.decision: Separate DB models for Pro flow (LessonProSession, ProSlide, ProQuestion)
decisions.reason: Cannot modify existing Lesson/Slide/ReviewQuestion models. Pro models store different data (learningOutcomes, assessments, textbookContent, 8 slide types, MC+MR answers with per-answer feedback).

decisions.decision: Pro prompt slugs prefixed with pro.* to avoid conflicts
decisions.reason: Existing prompts (slides.script, questions.review) must remain unchanged. Pro prompts (pro.slides.script, pro.questions.level1) coexist in same DB table.

decisions.decision: Per-lesson UI toggle for Pro Editor (not subject-level)
decisions.reason: More flexible — GV can try Pro on one lesson without committing all lessons. Nút ⚡ Studio Pro trên lesson card → /lessons/:id/pro route.

decisions.decision: Textbook step BEFORE slides in Pro flow
decisions.reason: Backward Design: textbook chapter provides grounded content for slide generation. Slides extract from textbook instead of AI generating from scratch.

decisions.decision: Lesson Pro pivot: from prompt-upgrade to Backend Agent paradigm
decisions.reason: AWF skills are AI-agent-side instructions (not backend services). Simply upgrading prompts is '25-30 days for incremental improvement'. Real differentiator is Human-AI Collaboration (worker PAUSE + user approve at each step), not 'better prompts'. Clone vid-worker Redis pattern + add approval mechanism.

decisions.decision: AWF skills cannot be directly integrated into web backend
decisions.reason: Skills (awf-textbook 716 lines, awf-pptx 169 lines, awf-question-gen 382 lines) are instructions for an AI agent that IS the AI model. Backend worker is Python CODE that calls AI API externally. Must 'translate' methodology into prompts (~200 words/step) + Python logic. Expect 80-90% quality of direct agent execution.

decisions.decision: Graphify + Harness MANDATORY for every /code phase
decisions.reason: User explicitly required full integration. Every phase must follow: (1) Harness intake gate (classify risk → create story for Normal+), (2) Graphify query before code, (3) implement, (4) Graphify --update after code, (5) Harness close (update story + TEST_MATRIX + decision records). This is PERMANENT — do not skip even if not reminded.

decisions.decision: Syllabus pipeline additive-only architecture
decisions.reason: No existing code modified. 4 new DB models (Syllabus, SyllabusBlock, SyllabusReference, SyllabusLesson). New SyllabusModule. Only additive changes to schema.prisma, app.module.ts, SubjectDetail.tsx, QuestionsController, Step6QuestionBank.

decisions.decision: OOXML unified strategy: docx.js + exceljs + pptxgenjs
decisions.reason: All 3 libraries already in project are ECMA-376 compliant. No new libs needed. docx.js supports portrait/landscape sections via SectionType.NEXT_PAGE + PageOrientation.

decisions.decision: MarkItDown for document-to-markdown conversion
decisions.reason: microsoft/markitdown installed on server. Used for: (1) syllabus DOCX import → AI parse → fill blocks, (2) reference file upload → markdown context for AI textbook generation. Supports PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX.

decisions.decision: 4 image sources for textbook: Imagen, Mermaid, Upload, None
decisions.reason: Platform serves multi-discipline users (not just programming). Code-based charts (plt.savefig) from AWF skill replaced with: AI Imagen (existing ImagenService), Mermaid CLI (mmdc → PNG), user upload, or skip images.

decisions.decision: AI Lesson Splitting uses OUTLINE model + LESSON_SPLIT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
decisions.reason: Reuses existing model config infrastructure. System prompt enforces JSON array output with {title, outline} per lesson.

decisions.decision: SyllabusLesson→Lesson bridge via 1:1 lessonId link
decisions.reason: Additive pattern — no changes to existing Lesson model. SyllabusLesson gains optional lessonId FK. Bridge prevents duplication by checking existence.

decisions.decision: Textbook generation uses Backward Design system prompt with Anti-AI phrasing rules
decisions.reason: TEXTBOOK_SYSTEM_PROMPT enforces: Bloom's taxonomy objectives, academic tone, specific examples, 2000-4000 words. Bans 'Trong bối cảnh hiện nay' and similar AI-typical phrases.

decisions.decision: Textbook status tracking: none → generating → done/error
decisions.reason: Simple 4-state model stored in SyllabusLesson.textbookStatus. No BullMQ needed — synchronous AI call with try/catch status transitions.

decisions.decision: Combined textbook DOCX export from all lessons
decisions.reason: Single DOCX with title page + chapter-per-lesson. Reuses SyllabusExportService's parseInlineFormatting() for markdown→OOXML conversion.

decisions.decision: Upgraded TEXTBOOK_SYSTEM_PROMPT to match AWF textbook skill standards
decisions.reason: Original prompt was generic English — missing Backward Design structure, Harvard narrative elements, Anti-AI vocabulary list, formula derivation chains, paragraph expansion rules, and running examples. New prompt enforces ALL AWF quality criteria in Vietnamese.

decisions.decision: DOCX export standard: Times New Roman 13pt, justified, A4 2/2/3/2cm margins, 1.3x spacing
decisions.reason: Vietnamese academic standard. Applied to both syllabus export (docx.js) and textbook export. Created reference.docx template for Pandoc-based markdown→DOCX conversion.

decisions.decision: Pandoc reference.docx template for textbook DOCX export
decisions.reason: Direct docx.js markdown→OOXML conversion was complex for rich content. Pandoc with --reference-doc=backend/assets/reference.docx produces correctly formatted academic documents with proper heading hierarchy.

decisions.decision: Multi-phase textbook pipeline (5 steps) instead of single-shot
decisions.reason: Single AI call produces inconsistent quality. 5-step pipeline (EXTRACT→PLAN→WRITE→ILLUSTRATE→REVIEW+FIX) with specialized prompts per step ensures Backward Design compliance, illustration generation, and Anti-AI self-correction.

decisions.decision: MermaidService with mmdc CLI + mermaid.ink fallback
decisions.reason: Local mmdc requires Puppeteer/Chrome (heavy on VPS). mermaid.ink API as zero-dependency fallback. Pattern mirrors MarkItDownService CLI proxy approach.

decisions.decision: Textbook assets stored in uploads/syllabus-textbook/<syllabusId>/<lessonId>/assets/
decisions.reason: Separate from datauser/ structure. Public route /files/public/syllabus-textbook/... serves images embedded in markdown without JWT.

decisions.decision: Reference limit raised from 3000 to 50000 chars per reference
decisions.reason: Academic textbooks are large (50K+ chars). 3000 chars was too restrictive for meaningful AI context extraction.

decisions.decision: AI-simulated code output instead of executing code
decisions.reason: Platform serves multiple disciplines (agriculture, business, etc.), not just programming. AI writes accurate output blocks without running code. Safer and more portable.

decisions.decision: AWF-style DOCX post-processing pipeline: Pandoc → python-docx
decisions.reason: Pandoc generates structure but cannot style code blocks with borders/shading. python-docx post-processor adds gray background (#F5F5F5), borders, Consolas font, LEFT alignment to all Source Code paragraphs. Graceful fallback to raw Pandoc output if post-process fails.

decisions.decision: Force font via w:rFonts XML instead of python-docx style.font.name
decisions.reason: Pandoc reference.docx uses Aptos (Word theme font). python-docx style.font.name doesn't override theme fonts. Direct XML w:rFonts with ascii/hAnsi/eastAsia/cs slots is the only reliable method.

decisions.decision: Force LEFT alignment via XML w:jc instead of paragraph.alignment=0
decisions.reason: python-docx treats LEFT (value 0) as 'default' and silently skips writing the XML element. Paragraph then inherits JUSTIFY from Normal style. Must use direct XML parse_xml('<w:jc w:val=left/>').

decisions.decision: Remove ALL frontend axios timeouts (set to 0)
decisions.reason: Dev server AI operations are unpredictable in duration. False-negative errors (frontend shows error but data saved in DB) confuse users. Backend never times out — frontend should match.

decisions.decision: ILLUSTRATE step uses HTML comment markers
decisions.reason: WRITE step inserts <!-- ILLUSTRATION: {type, description} --> markers. ILLUSTRATE step parses these + proposes additional illustrations. Decouples content writing from image generation.

decisions.decision: ViTTS admin 3-tier fallback: User cred → Admin cred → Gemini TTS
decisions.reason: Allows all users to use ViTTS voice without personal API key. Admin API key stored in system_configs. seed-configs.js upserts on Docker startup.

decisions.decision: Default models: gpt-5.5 (text), gpt-image-2 (image), vitts:design (TTS)
decisions.reason: All via CLIProxy except TTS via ViTTS admin. getDefaultForTask checks vitts.enabled FIRST before CLIProxy TTS.

decisions.decision: CLIProxy URL: http://152.67.112.145:8317 (direct IP, not domain)
decisions.reason: Domain cliproxy.hoclieu.id.vn was outdated. Direct IP is more reliable. Updated in .env, .env.example, docker-compose, migration SQL, seed-configs.js.

decisions.decision: seed-configs.js (standalone JS) instead of prisma db seed
decisions.reason: prisma db seed requires ts-node in Docker production image. Standalone JS script with @prisma/client import runs directly with node.

decisions.decision: ViTTS test connection: network error shows friendly message about VPS-only access
decisions.reason: ViTTS server (117.0.36.6:8888) only accessible from VPS network. Local dev will always get 'fetch failed'. Error message explains this instead of confusing admin.

decisions.decision: Tab reorder: Đề cương → Bài giảng → Video (default still opens Bài giảng)
decisions.reason: Syllabus-first workflow. Tab visual order changed but activeTab default remains 'lessons' for backward compatibility.

decisions.decision: PrismaClient init in standalone JS script (Prisma 7.x)
decisions.reason: Prisma 7.x removed 'datasources' option. Standalone scripts (like seed-configs.js) MUST use the adapter pattern: const pool = new Pool({ connectionString }); const adapter = new PrismaPg(pool); const prisma = new PrismaClient({ adapter }); And must pool.end() in finally block to prevent hanging.

patterns: NestJS module structure with controller/service/module
Factory pattern for TTS providers
Prisma for type-safe database access with pg adapter
React Context for lesson editor state (+ TanStack Query for server state)
6-step workflow with step tracking
PromptComposer: Role (system.role + Subject) + Task (from DB slug) + {output_language_instruction}
seedV2() in prompts.service.ts keeps DB and code in sync — auto-seed on startup
Multi-stage Docker builds
JWT with refresh token rotation
AES-256-GCM credential encryption
Dynamic model discovery with API classification (GEMINI, CLIPROXY, IMAGE_GEN)
refreshLessonDataOnly() pattern — refresh data without overwriting step state
Type-only imports in TypeScript (verbatimModuleSyntax)
OmniVoice async job polling pattern: POST → job_id → poll → download audio_url
ViTTS mode detection from saved modelName: vitts:ref:UUID → clone, vitts:design → design, else → auto
ImageGen URL rewrite: detect localhost in response URL → replace origin with config URL
PPTX audio injection via XML: Part+PackURI+audioFile XML element + relationship (bypasses broken add_movie)
JobConfig propagation pattern: pass JobConfig explicitly to worker services instead of using global variable imports
ManimGL headless render: xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 WxHx24' manim-render script.py SceneName -w --hd
ManimGL file output: videos/ relative to cwd. Search TEMP_DIR/videos/ and worker/videos/ for rendered files
ManimGL code auto-fix pattern: regex post-processor to fix AI mistakes (MathTex→Tex, Create→ShowCreation, t_min→t_range)
Video TTS voice propagation: TTSSelector saves to DB → backend reads via getModelForTask → passes via vitts.voice in job payload → worker uses vitts_voice
Scene-by-scene render: frontend polls individual scene status, worker mode=render-scene processes ONE scene and uploads clip to MinIO
Self-healing AI code gen: generate → AST validate → dry-run (xvfb) → if fail: send error+code to AI → fix → retry. Max 2 retries
Manim reference injection: keyword-match visual_desc against 4,915 3b1b patterns, inject top-5 code snippets as few-shot examples
Worker mode dispatch: mode field in job payload selects handler (render, script-only, audio-only, render-scene, regenerate-code, compose-only)
Clip streaming pattern: frontend uses <video src={API_BASE_URL}/scenes/:idx/stream/clip?token=JWT> → backend reads clipUrl from VideoScene → streams from MinIO
render-scene saves manimCode: orchestrator _report includes manimCode → processor passes to onSceneRenderDone → DB updated with both clipUrl and manimCode
Compose merges audio+video: compose_scene(clip, audio) uses FFmpeg tpad=stop_mode=clone to freeze last frame when video shorter than audio
Self-healing on polling: getVideo() checks for scenes stuck in 'rendering' > 5m and auto-recovers them based on presence of manimCode or clipUrl in DB

Zero-impact module pattern: New module imports shared services (PrismaModule, AIModule, TTSModule, etc.) but creates own models, controllers, services. Only additive changes to schema.prisma and app.module.ts.
Pro prompt namespace: All Pro prompts use 'pro.*' slug prefix (pro.backward.outcomes, pro.slides.script, etc.) to coexist with classic prompts in same DB table

⭐ MANDATORY Harness+Graphify per /code phase: (1) Harness classify risk → story file if Normal+ (2) graphify query before code (3) implement (4) graphify --update (5) Harness close (story status + TEST_MATRIX + decisions)
Harness risk classification: 0-1 flags=tiny, 2-3=normal, 4+=high-risk. Hard gates: Auth, Authorization, Data loss, Audit/security, External provider
Harness story files: docs/stories/US-XXX-title.md from docs/templates/story.md. Normal lane requires story + validation expectations + TEST_MATRIX update
MarkItDown CLI Proxy pattern: write temp file → spawn markitdown → capture stdout → cleanup. 30s timeout. Supports DOCX/PDF/PPTX/XLSX/TXT.
Syllabus DOCX Import: MarkItDown → markdown → AI JSON parse (10 blocks) → Prisma $transaction bulk update
Syllabus DOCX Export: 3-section OOXML — portrait (header→assessment) → landscape (content_detail) → portrait (update_log + signatures)
Reference upload: save file to uploads/syllabus-refs/<syllabusId>/ → MarkItDown extract → store markdown in DB → list/delete API
SyllabusExportService: inline bold/italic markdown parsing → TextRun[], bullet detection, landscape PageOrientation for wide tables
AI Lesson Splitting: content_detail + objectives → LLM → JSON [{title, outline}] → batch SyllabusLesson creation in $transaction
Lesson Bridge: SyllabusLesson.lessonId 1:1 link → prevents duplicate Lesson creation. Button shows 'Tạo bài giảng' or 'Mở bài giảng' based on link state
Textbook generation: lesson outline + objectives + description + reference summaries (max 3, 3000 chars each) → AI → textbookContent field
Textbook DOCX: markdown headers (# ## ###) → TITLE_SIZE/HEADING_SIZE/bold-italic TextRun. Bullets + inline formatting preserved. Single-section portrait A4
Editable textbook: <details> collapsible → click 'Chỉnh sửa' → textarea + Save/Cancel → PUT /textbook → reload
Multi-phase textbook: generateTextbookPro() orchestrates 5 AI calls with phase tracking (textbookPhase field). Frontend polls GET /textbook-status every 3s for progress bar.

Illustration pipeline: AI outputs JSON [{type:'mermaid'|'ai_image', content, caption}] → MermaidService.renderToPng() or ImagenService.generateImage() → FileStorageService.saveTextbookAsset() → markdown ![caption](publicUrl)
WRITE step inserts <!-- ILLUSTRATION: {...} --> HTML comment markers → ILLUSTRATE step replaces with rendered images. Extra images appended at end.
CSS specificity gotcha: SyllabusPanel.css .lesson-title overridden by LessonEditorV2.css .lesson-title (28px/700). Fix: parent selector .syllabus-lessons-list .lesson-title

DOCX code block styling: reference.docx (style-level) + docx_postprocess.py (run-level) dual-layer approach. Reference template sets Source Code style; post-processor force-overrides every individual run for 100% coverage.

Pandoc image embedding: markdown ![caption](/files/public/...) URLs must be converted to absolute disk paths before Pandoc. Pattern: /files/public/syllabus-textbook/X/Y → {cwd}/uploads/syllabus-textbook/X/Y
gotchas: ⭐ Image model name: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' NOT 'gemini-2.5-flash-preview-image-generation' (404 error)
⭐ Image SDK: Use @google/genai (new) NOT @google/generative-ai (legacy)
⭐ Image generation: Use client.models.generateContentStream() with config.responseModalities=['IMAGE','TEXT']
⭐ Browser tags cannot send JWT headers — use public route /files/public/... for images
⭐ Vite proxy: Add '/files' proxy to forward static file requests to backend port 3001
⭐ GEMINI_API_KEY must be in .env for image generation fallback when user has no key in DB
⭐ buildFullPrompt for ALL prompts that need language injection (speaker-notes, optimize-notes, slides.design, questions)
⭐ Always sync prompts.service.ts seedV2() when updating prompts in DB
⭐ ExcelJS import: Use 'import * as ExcelJS from exceljs' (static), NOT 'await import()'
⭐ Template background paths: URLs like /files/public/system/templates/{uuid}/... map to datauser/system/templates/{uuid}/...
⭐ ViTTS voice ID normalization: Strip 'vitts:' prefix before sending to API
⭐ ViTTS synthesize-with-saved-ref endpoint: Use form-urlencoded (URLSearchParams), NOT JSON body
⭐ CLIProxy TTS modalities: Must use UPPERCASE 'AUDIO' — lowercase causes 400 error
⭐ CLIProxy TTS response format: Audio in message.images[].image_url.url as data URI, NOT message.audio.data
⭐ CLIProxy TTS model name: Strip 'cliproxy:' prefix before API call
⭐ CLIProxy TTS fallback: Override dto.model to 'gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts' for Gemini SDK
⭐ refreshLessonData() overwrites currentStep — use refreshLessonDataOnly() to avoid navigation regression
⭐ Speaker notes in 3 places: Lesson.slideScript, Slide table, SlideAudio table — must sync all 3
⭐ AI-generated outline JSON wrapped in ```json...``` markdown — must strip before JSON.parse
⭐ Optimize prompt pitfall: 'viết lại' causes AI to compress narrative→bullet lists (30-56% content loss). Use >=95% word count constraint
⭐ Admin model discovery: Do NOT use process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY — key is in DB (api_keys table). Use ApiKeysService.getActiveKey()
🐳 Prisma 7 Docker: Requires Node 22+, OpenSSL on Alpine, binaryTargets: ['native', 'linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x']
🐳 Prisma 7 Docker: Remove 'url' from schema.prisma datasource — must use prisma.config.ts
🐳 Prisma Migration: Dockerfile CMD must run 'npx prisma migrate deploy' BEFORE 'node dist/src/main'
🐳 Vite production: VITE_API_URL baked at BUILD time — use nginx proxy /api/ for runtime flexibility
🐳 Docker Compose: ports: '3001:3001' REQUIRED to expose backend
🚀 GHCR login: echo 'PAT_TOKEN' | docker login ghcr.io -u username --password-stdin
JWT expiresIn must be number (seconds)
Prisma 7: REQUIRES @prisma/adapter-pg + pg driver — no direct connection
JwtStrategy.validate() returns {id, email, role} — use user.id NOT user.userId
Frontend default API_URL port 3000 — need VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001
CSS class conflict: UserSettings.css .modal-content {max-width:420px} overrides AdminPage — use specific class with !important
Nginx default proxy_read_timeout is 60s — AI requests need 600s (not 180s — questions/speaker notes can take 2-5 min)
⭐ OmniVoice generate-clone-ref: MUST use application/x-www-form-urlencoded (URLSearchParams), NOT JSON.
⭐ OmniVoice Voice Design instruct format: 'female, young adult, high pitch' — NOT 'A female, young speaker'.
⭐ ViTTS vittsMode detection: saved modelName 'vitts:auto' — ALWAYS default to 'auto' mode, not 'clone'.
⭐ Flux/ComfyUI Image Gen uses OpenAI-compatible endpoint but only returns `{data: [{b64_json: '...'}]}`.
⭐ Prompt Composer: {output_language_instruction} placeholder injected at runtime — English prompts + dynamic language = correct output.
⭐ ComfyUI API Crash: size `256x256` or steps `4` specifically crashes Flux.dev.
🆕 ImageGen URL rewrite: Remote Flux API returns http://localhost:8000/image/xxx.png — backend rewrites to configured host (e.g. http://117.0.36.6:8000/image/xxx.png).
🆕 ModelSelector must include IMAGE_GEN category in discovery/merge/sort logic — otherwise Flux models invisible in dropdown.
🆕 Gemini SDK fallback: When isImageGenModel=true, MUST use GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL constant — NOT the ImageGen model name (flux-image → 404).
🆕 regenerateSlideContent: Must use 'slides.design' slug — 'slides.optimize_content' does NOT exist.
🆕 Speaker notes prompts: MUST include 'PLAIN TEXT ONLY' rule — TTS engines cannot read Markdown, bullets, emojis.
🆕 GeminiService.optimizeFluxPrompt() uses process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY directly (not DB key). If key invalid, falls back to original prompt (non-critical warning).
⭐⭐ python-pptx 1.0.2 add_movie() BROKEN for audio: 'Part object has no attribute sha1'. Must use direct Part+PackURI+XML to inject audio.
⭐ PPTX audio injection: audio frame uses a:audioFile (not a:videoFile). Must create TWO relationships: officeDocument/audio + microsoft/media.
⭐ ViTTS production: baseUrl must use port 8888. Port 8000 is Flux/ImageGen.
⭐ ViTTS omniCloneRef: Use FormData directly, NOT stringified body. Hardcoded local paths (f:/...) crash on Linux VPS.
⭐ VPS false-negative errors: Backend completes but frontend shows error due to nginx proxy_read_timeout being too short. Set to 600s minimum.
⭐ Redis/BullMQ nested object flattening: Make sure to stringify full objects (like job_config) before pushing, otherwise objects may get flattened.
⭐⭐ ManimGL v1.7.2: NO MathTex class! Use Tex(r'formula') for math. MathTex is ManimCE-only → NameError.
⭐⭐ manimgl vs manim-render: manimgl leaves _temp.mp4 (corrupt) in xvfb/headless. Use manim-render binary instead.
⭐ ManimGL scene_file_writer.py line 304: ended_with_interrupt=True → temp file NOT renamed to final. Root cause of _temp.mp4 issue.
⭐ ManimGL color constants (WHITE, YELLOW, BLUE, RED, etc.) ARE supported. Previous prompt wrongly forced hex-only colors.
⭐ ManimGL .animate syntax IS supported (e.g., obj.animate.shift(RIGHT), obj.animate.scale(2)).
⭐ ManimGL ParametricCurve uses t_range=[min,max,step], FunctionGraph uses x_range=[min,max,step]. NOT t_min/t_max.
⭐ LaTeX packages for ManimGL: texlive-latex-extra + texlive-fonts-extra + texlive-science + texlive-latex-recommended must be installed.
⭐ Video TTS voice: backend buildJobPayload must read user's TTS config from ModelConfigService, NOT just cliproxy.defaultTTSModel.
🆕 Prisma shadow database error: P3006 migration history dirty. Use 'npx prisma db push' instead of 'prisma migrate dev' when shadow DB has stale migrations.
🆕 Worker mode dispatch: job payload must include both 'mode' and 'sceneIndex'. Worker.py done payload must include 'sceneUpdates' array for processor to update DB.
🆕 ManimGL Tex Vietnamese text: NEVER put Vietnamese diacritics (ố, ế, ứ) inside Tex/TexText — will crash LaTeX. Use Text() for Vietnamese.
🆕 ManimGL API differences from ManimCE: ShowCreation not Create, Tex not MathTex, get_graph not plot, add_coordinate_labels not get_axis_labels
⭐⭐ Zombie workers: Old worker.py processes survive service restarts and compete for Redis blpop queue. MUST kill ALL worker.py processes on stop, not just PID-tracked one.

⭐ render-scene manimCode loss: Worker generates code + renders in one shot but _report done payload originally didn't include manimCode → UI showed empty code field. Fixed by adding manimCode to sceneUpdates.

⭐ Clip preview 404: Frontend tried accessing clipUrl directly as URL path but it's a MinIO object path (videos/userId/videoId/clips/scene_000.mp4). Need backend streaming endpoint to proxy from MinIO.

⭐ Prisma 7 standalone scripts: Cannot use 'new PrismaClient()' from node -e or ts-node directly — requires proper module resolution and prisma.config.ts. Use psql or Python for DB queries outside NestJS.
⭐ regenerateSceneCode must update scene status to 'rendering' BEFORE dispatching job, otherwise frontend polling won't activate and UI gets stuck.
⭐ Backend hot-reload during worker processing causes Redis subscriber to lose connection, missing 'done' messages. Fixed with 5-minute self-healing fallback in getVideo() polling.
⭐ Step 3 visual_desc editing: AI code regeneration requires injecting the updated visual_desc from the DB into the job payload script.
⭐ MarkItDown error handling: Python tracebacks are captured in stderr but process fails silently on frontend if timeout limits it. Unlimited timeout helps.

⭐ MarkItDown PDF Support: By default, markitdown lacks dependencies to parse PDFs (Throws MissingDependencyException for pdfminer.six). MUST install `pip install "markitdown[all]"` globally or in virtualenv to enable PDF/Audio support.
⭐ Textbook DOCX heading sizes: H1 = 16pt (TITLE_SIZE), H2 = 14pt (HEADING_SIZE). Must not be too large in exported DOCX — reduces readability for academic materials.
⭐ Pandoc reference.docx: Must be a valid DOCX with styles defined (Normal, Heading 1-3, etc.). Located at backend/assets/reference.docx. Pandoc uses it for font, margins, spacing.
⭐ MarkItDown timeout: Remove timeout limit entirely (set to 0) for academic PDFs. Heavy PDF textbooks (>3MB, >500 pages) can take several minutes to parse.
⭐ CSS specificity: LessonEditorV2.css defines global .lesson-title {font-size:28px; font-weight:700}. SyllabusPanel must use parent selector (.syllabus-lessons-list .lesson-title) to override.
⭐ Textbook PRO timeout: 600s axios timeout needed (5 AI calls sequential). Frontend uses 600_000ms.
⭐ MermaidService: mmdc CLI may not be installed on server. Always fallback to mermaid.ink API. Check availability once and cache result.

⭐⭐ process.cwd() in NestJS backend resolves to backend/ directory (not project root). Path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend', 'assets/') creates DOUBLE 'backend/backend/assets/' path. Use path.join(process.cwd(), 'assets/') instead.
⭐⭐ python-docx paragraph.alignment = 0 (LEFT) is SILENTLY IGNORED — python-docx considers LEFT as 'inherit from style' and doesn't write XML. Must use direct XML: parse_xml('<w:jc w:val=left/>')

⭐ Pandoc reference.docx Aptos font: Word 365+ uses Aptos as default theme font. python-docx style.font.name cannot override theme fonts. Must use w:rFonts XML with all 4 font slots (ascii, hAnsi, eastAsia, cs).
⭐ Pandoc ```output language: Not recognized by Pandoc — causes code block to render as plain text without syntax highlighting. Convert to ```text before passing to Pandoc.
⭐ Frontend axios timeout:0 means NO timeout (unlimited). All AI API calls should use timeout:0 on dev server to prevent false-negative errors.
conventions: API routes: /lessons/:id/resource
Admin routes: /admin/...
Prisma map() for snake_case in DB
Frontend pages in src/pages/, components in src/components/
DTOs use class-validator
Services throw NestJS exceptions
Dark theme with glassmorphism UI
Controller @CurrentUser() returns { id: string }, not userId
Use refreshLessonDataOnly() when navigating between steps
ALL system prompts written in English with {output_language_instruction} for dynamic language control
Video scene API routes: /subjects/:subjectId/videos/:videoId/scenes/:sceneIndex/action
Syllabus API routes: /subjects/:id/syllabus/* for subject-scoped, /syllabus/:id/* for syllabus-scoped
Harness story naming: US-XXX-short-kebab-title.md in docs/stories/
Graphify re-index after each phase: graphify . --update
Decision records in docs/decisions/ for architecture changes
Reference file storage: uploads/syllabus-refs/<syllabusId>/<timestamp>-<sanitized_name>
SyllabusModule imports: PrismaModule, AIModule, ApiKeysModule, ModelConfigModule, FileStorageModule. Providers: SyllabusService, MarkItDownService, MermaidService, SyllabusExportService
Textbook timeout: 180s for classic, 600s for Pro (5-step pipeline). Frontend shows loading message immediately
Textbook export filename: Giao_trinh_<subject_name>.docx
Textbook assets: uploads/syllabus-textbook/<syllabusId>/<lessonId>/assets/ served via /files/public/syllabus-textbook/...
